project: Wuxia Life P66 Merchant Trilogy Success-Cost Differentiation
description: Add the smallest bounded runtime-visible differentiation that makes apprentice, tavern, and peasant merchant success feel costly in different ways, while preserving the existing merchant trilogy skeleton and avoiding a broader merchant content wave.

userStories.title: Audit current success-cost signals
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an audit of the current success-cost signals so P66 targets the real thin spots instead of layering generic hardship on top of the trilogy.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize the existing cost signals across apprentice, tavern, and peasant merchant routes
Separate route-specific burdens from generic merchant hardship that still reads shared
Save docs/test-reports/p66-success-cost-signal-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
userStories.notes: Audit saved at docs/test-reports/p66-success-cost-signal-audit.md. Identified payoff phase as thinnest spot.

userStories.title: Lock P66 success-cost scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P66 stays focused on success-cost differentiation instead of growing into a broader merchant expansion stage.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P66 to success-cost differentiation only
Define allowed layers: light configuration, expression, proof, and narrow tests
List forbidden expansions: full merchant wave, success-shape mainline work, and playtest platformization
Save docs/test-reports/p66-success-cost-scope-contract.md

userStories.title: Define apprentice success-cost contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a bounded cost contract for the apprentice merchant path so its success feels tied to partnership, bookkeeping, and control risks rather than generic merchant debt.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the primary cost sources for the apprentice merchant route
Tie the cost profile to the existing apprentice-to-partnership-to-merchant path
Keep the apprentice burden distinct from generic merchant debt or generic hardship
Record the contract in the PRD or an appendix artifact
userStories.notes: Apprentice cost contract defined in PRD Appendix A.1 — partnership/control/bookkeeping cost profile.

userStories.title: Define tavern success-cost contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a bounded cost contract for the tavern merchant path so its success feels tied to favor backlash, relationship debt, and information distortion.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the primary cost sources for the tavern merchant route
Tie the cost profile to the existing familiar-guest, referral, and social-network path
Keep the tavern burden distinct from generic merchant debt or generic hardship
Record the contract in the PRD or an appendix artifact
userStories.notes: Tavern cost contract defined in PRD Appendix A.2 — favor/network/information-distortion cost profile.

userStories.title: Define peasant success-cost contract

acceptanceCriteria: Define the primary cost sources for the peasant merchant route
Tie the cost profile to the existing grain-route, travel, and heavy-bet path
Keep the peasant burden distinct from generic merchant debt or generic hardship
Record the contract in the PRD or an appendix artifact
userStories.notes: Peasant cost contract defined in PRD Appendix A.3 — cargo/travel/timing-bet cost profile.

userStories.title: Wire success-cost differentiation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the three cost profiles wired through bounded carriers and markers so players can feel different burdens without introducing a new merchant system.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement the differentiation only through existing merchant-trilogy carriers, markers, or expression-adjacent wiring
Do not introduce a new merchant framework or economy system
Existing P55, P58, P59, P61, P63, and P64 evidence does not regress
Keep the differentiated routes stably inside the existing merchant trilogy structure
userStories.notes: Wired through existing expression framework in src/p50/sampleLineExpression.ts. No new systems. All P58/P59/P61/P63/P64 tests pass.

userStories.title: Add player-facing cost expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want each merchant route's burden to read as my own kind of pain rather than as one shared merchant stress line.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least three cost-specific readable signals across existing expression surfaces
Make apprentice, tavern, and peasant pain sources distinguishable to the player
Do not add new UI components
Add or update focused expression tests
userStories.notes: 3+ groups of cost-specific signals: (1) payoff cost reflection, (2) cost label persistence, (3) age-40 cost weight. All player-visible.

userStories.title: Add targeted success-cost proof
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded proof artifact showing that the three merchant routes now pay different prices for success.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce one comparison-style targeted proof artifact
Show success-cost differentiation evidence for apprentice, tavern, and peasant merchant routes
Do not require full lifetime comparative exhaust
Ensure the proof directly supports the next success-shape stage
userStories.notes: Proof saved at docs/test-reports/p66-success-cost-differentiation-proof.md. 3-dimension comparison. Directly supports P67.

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests guarding the cost differentiation so later edits do not flatten the pain back into one merchant line.
acceptanceCriteria: Cover markers, player-facing expression, and comparison-level assertions with narrow checks
Reuse the existing merchant trilogy harnesses
Do not rewrite the full merchant test suite
Relevant commands pass
userStories.notes: 4 new test functions in tests/p50SampleLineExpressionTests.ts: cost label persistence, payoff cost reflection, age-40 cost weight, comparison distinction. All pass.

userStories.title: Produce P66 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report stating exactly how the three merchant routes now pay different prices for success and what remains for the next stage.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p66-success-cost-differentiation-closure-report.md
Summarize the audit, contracts, configuration, expression, proof, and tests
State the boundary between P66 and P67
List larger merchant or new-route work that remains deferred
